Author-directed development; proposed chronology and counts · 2026-11-06
Explore the interactive shelter atlas
Locate this haven or microsystem in the atlas →
Origin and setting
Repeatable saved states repeatedly restored interrupted tasks.

Human system: Lattice research replay service, Observatory Hearth. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Local process
Verified Return compares saved states before restoration.
Proposed local course
The haven remains functioning in this proposal and later attempts to reassemble damaged arrivals from saved versions. Its success with local tasks does not validate every reconstruction.
Unresolved interpretations
A compatible reconstruction may restore processing without restoring an original experiencer; restoration advocates and doubters can coexist here.
Atlas placement

Origin step -2. 0: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 1: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 2: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 3: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 4: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 5: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 6: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 7: functioning (0 associated systems lost). These placements elaborate the current hypothetical map; they are not independently verified casualties. A functioning haven can lose continuity among particular arrivals without changing its community census status.
